info.name: Full text search - OpenSearch Platform
info.description:
Extension to allow the _Full text search_ app to use OpenSearch as a backend.
OpenSearch was forked from ElasticSearch in 2021 due to a change in their license. OpenSearch is published under the OSI certified Apache license. OpenSearch includes free cross-cluster replication, LDAP/OpenID/SAML authentication, IP filtering, configurable retention period, anomaly detection, tableau connector, and machine learning features whereas those features are non-free with ElasticSearch and would require a subscription.
